identity.name: 1815 Chronograph
identity.one_liner: A flyback column-wheel chronograph built on the same movement architecture as the Datograph, fitted into a smaller, date-free case with a pulsometer scale.

narrative.story: The 1815 Chronograph borrows the Datograph's hand-wound, column-wheel flyback movement but drops the date display, which lets the case sit 1.5mm thinner than its sibling. This reference, released in 2017, pairs a solid-silver black dial with white Arabic numerals and a pulsometer scale ringing the edge, a period detail for reading pulse rate over thirty beats.
narrative.collector_notes: The pulsometer scale and Arabic numeral set are specific to this dial variant; other 1815 Chronograph references use tachymeter scales or Roman numerals, so collectors match the exact reference number to the dial before assuming interchangeability.
